name: Under the Thorns
source:
Clara, a maid, arrives at a shrouded manor. Rumor has it that her new employer is dangerous and has dismissed 13 maids before her. What secrets is he hiding? A captivating tale of mystery, suspense, and romance. 

[From [url=https://everium.itch.io/underthethorns]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女仆克拉拉来到一座阴暗的庄园。有传言说她的新雇主很危险，在她之前已经解雇了13名女佣。他到底隐藏着什么秘密？一个充满神秘、悬疑和浪漫的迷人故事。

[来自[url=https://everium.itch.io/underthethorns]itch.io[/url]]
